Is it possible to have a website that can float around the web (bouncing from point to point like TOR requests, I suppose) so as to avoid detecting where it originates from, while maintaining all of the data? Just curious, thanks!
Is it at all possible to have a website that "floats" around the net?
Freenet, I2P, IPFS to name a few.

You should look into mesh nets. If we're ever going to take back control of the internet, it probably will look similar to a mesh net.

The basic idea is that a series of wireless routers communicate directly with one another instead of all communicating with a node that passes the info back and forth. Right now we have nodes (ISPs) that collect and host all incoming data. In a mesh net you host your own data, and people connect directly to you.
